issue: Main window visibly faded for about 100-140 ms after starting capture; IsWindowVisible was already false at 6-30 ms, but DWM kept compositing a fade.
method: 22 fps GDI full-screen capture around a real/synthetic pointerdown; compare the home crop against the pre-click frame.

beforeFix.note: Home remained visible and faded across several frames; frame at +130 ms still showed the home over the desktop.

afterFix.note: No multi-frame fade; the first captured frame after hide already shows the desktop/overlay. Frame at +30 ms shows the home fully gone.

fix: BrowserWindow.setOpacity(0) before hide(); setOpacity(1) before show()/restore().
